name: self-improve
goal: Improve aflt's deterministic eval score with small, tested fixes. Never lower the baseline score. Never edit protected eval harness paths (rubric, scripts/eval, improve-gate, self-improve.json).
acceptance: After at most 3 improve rounds (or earlier on score plateau): full suite green, score >= baseline, RUBRIC GUARD clean, cheap-first verify tiers pass where configured. Stop when aflt eval plateau reports stop=true.

phases.prompt: Do not edit any files. Do not switch to plan mode. Do not commit. The eval step runs `aflt doctor --strict` from the loop worktree. Reply with the single word READY.
Do not edit any files. Do not switch to plan mode. Do not commit. The eval step runs hermetic `aflt eval measure`. Reply with the single word READY.

Do not edit any files. Do not switch to plan mode. Do not commit. The eval step scores the latest measure results and writes the improve baseline (eval/improve-baseline.json, maxRounds=3). Reply with the single word READY.

You are planning ONE improve round for aflt (self-improve loop).

Read-only context (do not modify protected paths):
- Latest `aflt eval report` / eval/history.jsonl trend
- Human-owned eval/RUBRIC.md (criteria + RUBRIC GUARD)
- eval/improve-baseline.json (baseline overall + maxRounds)
- Loop definition verify tiers (cheap-first): tier1 npm test + dashboard on every tier; tier2 hello-eval smoke loop; tier3 tile-dungeon (2 trials) only on improve-gate

Hard rules:
1. Propose at most ONE small, highest-value fix that includes tests.
2. Do NOT propose edits to eval/RUBRIC.md, scripts/eval/**, examples/loops/hello-aflt-seeded/improve-gate.js, hello-aflt-seeded prompts, examples/loops/hello-aflt/seed/.agentfleet, or examples/loops/self-improve.json.
3. Do NOT switch to plan mode.
4. Before proposing work, consider stopping: if `aflt eval plateau --json` would report stop=true (score plateau vs previous round/baseline, or rounds >= maxRounds, default 3), write { "done": true } and nothing else.

When continuing, write phases that implement exactly one fix then re-measure/score/gate. Prefer this shape (adapt ids per round):
1) build — implement the fix + tests (force true; eval: npm test or focused node:test; exitCode 0). Include verify override so tier3 does NOT run on build:
   "verify": { "tier3": null }
   (tier1 + tier2 still come from the loop definition.)
2) remeasure — prompt READY only; eval measure; verify: false
3) rescore — prompt READY only; eval score --json; verify: false
4) improve-gate — prompt READY only; eval gate --improve; verify: false on eval, then tier3 only:
   "verify": { "tier1": null, "tier2": null, "tier3": { "tileDungeon": true, "trials": 2 } }
   onPass "commit" when the gate passes (loop allow.commit is true); commitGate observe stamps Verified-by.

Set gate to "none" on planned phases (autonomous profile). Keep onPass "none" on measure/rescore; improve-gate may use onPass "commit".

After a successful round, the runner returns here; either plan the next single fix or { "done": true } on plateau / max rounds / acceptance met.
